purpose: Frozen eight-file workload for the P2-F host-comparability pilot. No result is recorded here.

ci_reference.note: Per-file elapsed values are read from that run's per-shard artifacts. Every listed file passed there; none is censored.

command.note: Same runner and job count as the production fast gate; NOT the shard flags. Per-file elapsed is the comparable quantity, not total CI wall.

acceptance.host: ubuntu 24.04, x86_64, racket 8.10, jobs 4, all recorded fields present
acceptance.integrity: warm-up + five measured artifacts; exactly eight paths per run; every status pass; zero timeouts/failures/missing
acceptance.stability: (max total wall - min total wall) / median total wall <= 0.15 over the five measured runs
acceptance.comparability: for each file, median(pilot)/ci_elapsed in [0.5,2.0]; pooled median ratio in [0.67,1.5]
acceptance.isolation: one runner per invocation; no nested runner or shard flags; the only .github addition is the dispatch-only pilot workflow (no push/PR trigger, no test selection); tested tree pinned by the four-path diff
acceptance.provenance: cache state, preparation overhead, load and exact argv per run; warm-up excluded from statistics
